items.name: 216 Maintenance
items.desc: Manages facilities for brands like Starbucks, Amazon, Tesla, and CVS across the Midwest. Adeptos replaced manual tracking systems with a unified AI infrastructure, automating job tracking, technician workflows, and invoicing.

items.name: Valvetronic Designs
items.desc: 8-figure automotive brand. Reduced support team from 20 to 5 people. Adeptos manages customer service and high-ticket sales conversations averaging $7,000+ per purchase.

items.name: Proyectamos y Edificamos
items.desc: Colombian real estate development and construction company: they promote, market, and build housing and civil works—from urban planning to retail and mixed-use—for different market segments. Adeptos keeps every answer aligned with live inventory, unit specs, and delivery timelines.

items.name: FR Hotel
items.desc: Hospitality in Ibagué: a full guest experience with 42 rooms and suites (inspired by Pijao naming), Nativo restaurant, rooftop cocktail garden, and Ikigai spa. Adeptos answers booking-style questions, room categories, and amenity details around the clock so reservations and front desk can focus on in-house guests.

testimonials.author: Operations lead
testimonials.text: Before Adeptos, after-hours pages lived in voicemail. Now the agent captures scope, site codes, and SLA tier—our coordinators start Monday with structured work orders instead of playing phone tag.

testimonials.author: Brandon S.
testimonials.text: I got this exhaust for my Ferrari 458 and I could not be happier! The sound is absolutely incredible and the quality is top-notch. Adeptos helped me get answers fast — no waiting, no runaround.

testimonials.author: Justin B.
testimonials.text: Not only does Valvetronic provide exceptional exhaust systems, but they also have the best support team I've ever dealt with. Every question answered instantly, even at midnight.

testimonials.author: Commercial team
testimonials.text: The Adeptos agent absorbed our full project portfolio—phases, unit mixes, pricing bands, and handover dates—so prospects get precise answers 24/7. Qualified leads are up sharply; our reps now step in when someone already understands the offering instead of repeating the same brochure talk.

testimonials.author: Guest experience lead
testimonials.text: Guests were asking the same things at 11 p.m.—room types, Nativo hours, spa bookings, how to reach the rooftop bar. The Adeptos agent speaks from our real room grid and service stack, so WhatsApp and web inquiries turn into confident next steps instead of endless 'we'll check and call you back.'
